feature: Article_ref join + regex fix in reorg_by_domain_md.py
scope: Add article_ref-based fallback join in scripts/preprocess/reorg_by_domain_md.py. Parser A: fix clause_id regex (accept digits in prefix like NIS2), also extract article_refs from YAML to build secondary index article_to_subs. Parser B: after clause_id match attempt, extract article_refs from section header and try exact + prefix match against article_to_subs. Add coverage report at methodology-00/PREPROCESSING_by_domain/audit/coverage_by_reg.md with per-reg stats and known limitations. No regression in the merged D-XX.Y.md structure (Parts 1-4). methodology-00/PREPROCESSING/ remains READ-ONLY.

risks: DORA match rate ceiling ~50% due to corpus gaps (77 articles in Ambiguity with no SecurityRule) — documented as known limitation
NIS2 short-form 'NIS2-CNN' (T3 narrative references) cannot be mapped without manual table — documented
CRA 'CRA-DNN' definitions (Ambiguity-only, no SecurityRule equivalent) cannot be mapped — documented
Many-to-many via article_ref: header 'Art. 9(2)' may match multiple SRs (3 DORA-SRs share it) — union of sub_domains is the intended behaviour, no duplication within a single merged file
If article_ref extraction breaks (regex change in YAML format), fallback produces 0 matches silently — mitigated by per-reg logging showing clause_id vs article_ref split
